matchingDiagnostics.description: Snapshot candidate counts and work actually evaluated; not a proof that every global combination was searched. Listing and unique-product counts are separate. Numeric preferences and health advice never reject candidates.

anyOf.description: Optional pointer to an existing selectable, nonempty, distinct positive-coverage option. Present the closest result and this alternative with their existing gaps, goods price and pill information. Null when none qualifies or continued intake already covers every target.

role.description: requested_objective is the primary profile-weighted requested objective; fewer_concerns is a distinct unchanged-constraint alternative. Other values are legacy saved-plan roles.

items.description: References only. Fetch details.sections=[advice] for these optionIds to read complete findings and sources.

planAdviceIds.description: Plan-wide flags in advice. Full plan-wide findings are available in details.sections=[advice].safetyGuidance.

s92.description: Verified nonnegative contributions when actual is unknown. This is a lower bound, not an exact total; exact delta and percentage stay null.

s0.description: Advisory numeric preference comparison. actual/preferred/delta use unit; percent is signed deviation from a positive preference and null for zero, absent preference or unknown actual. More than 20% above a positive preference, or any positive amount above zero, is prominent; selection and purchase remain available.

s3.description: Dimensionless normalized dose deviation: 1 equals 100%. total=under+over+2*limit, using symmetric deviations from requested targets, normalized newly added dose above an explicitly known continued-dose reference for unrequested nutrients, and additional applicable upper-limit excess. Unknown or estimated continued doses never create a reference denominator. This is a dose-fit ranking measure, not a clinical risk or approval score.

s1.description: Complete plan request. Replacement revisions reset omitted optional fields. Agreed targets are not diagnoses. Resolved nutrient amounts must represent at least one nanogram, one CFU, or 0.001 ml/serving; IU precision depends on nutrient form. Below-precision errors report the exact field and permitted minimum.

s69.description: Amount in the stated currency's minor units; unavailable values are null or absent, never fabricated zero.

s4.description: Physical administration evidence: unitsPerServing and packQuantity use physicalUnit; doseIncrement is the smallest measurable quantity in that unit. Null means unknown, never an inferred capsule or pack size. Servings per day multiply these labelled serving quantities; instructions and health reference limits remain advice.

s70.description: Equal-weight average of capped proportional dose coverage across every requested target, including unresolved and optional targets. Partial coverage is distinct from fully met target count.

s6.description: Quadratic advisory overrun: 0.25 × profile multiplier × importance (0.25/1/4) × (positive overrun / scale)^2. Incomplete amounts use a verified lower bound for scoring only; actual remains null. No eligibility cutoff.

s7.description: Versioned shared ranking breakdown. overallPenalty = unchanged raw dosePenalty + total practical penalty. Smaller is preferred under the same profile only, subject to required/core protection. Pills/products are daily; price is THB minor units. First-order price is used for routine cost, monthly_30_days only for an explicitly identified web budget preference. Uncertainty is disclosed, never a fabricated exact measurement. These optimisation scores are not medical risk ratings.
